standard_prerequisites: complete local Noetherian rings are excellent (More on Algebra, Proposition more-algebra-proposition-ubiquity-excellent) and excellence is preserved by polynomial rings
the map from a G-ring to its completion is regular (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-map-G-ring-to-completion-regular)
smooth ring maps are regular and regular ring maps are closed under composition (More on Algebra, Section more-algebra-section-regular)
core_obligations: Prove that for A adic Noetherian and p a rig-closed prime, the ring map A/p -> A/p{x_1,...,x_n} is regular; in particular A{x_1,...,x_n} tensor kappa(p) is geometrically regular over kappa(p)
proof_roadmap: A/p is a complete local Noetherian ring, hence excellent, and so is its polynomial ring A/p[x_1,...,x_n].
The completion map A/p[x_1,...,x_n] -> A/p{x_1,...,x_n} is regular by the G-ring-to-completion lemma.
A/p -> A/p[x_1,...,x_n] is smooth hence regular, and the composition of regular maps is regular; the geometric regularity of the fibre over kappa(p) follows.
difficulty_reason: H2: a regularity bookkeeping lemma chaining excellence and the completion lemma.
